text.aria-label: Title text 'D8, labelled event 177: -2.41 MW for 4.2 days from 2025-10-11. 580 status: not seen by the power rule (label not verified by the power readings). Same dates as the label at D5. NGED's labels are known to be imperfect, so a forecast that does not follow the label is not an error. Black solid: observed power. Blue dashed: observed power minus the labelled depth. Grey: C0 median and q05-q95 band. Orange: C2 median and band. Grey shade: the labelled event. Sky-blue bar along the bottom: gate on or held.'
text.tspan: D8, labelled event 177: -2.41 MW for 4.2 days from 2025-10-11. 580 status: not seen by the power rule (label not verified by the power readings). Same dates as the label at D5.
NGED's labels are known to be imperfect, so a forecast that does not follow the label is not an error. Black solid: observed power. Blue dashed: observed power minus the labelled depth.
Grey: C0 median and q05-q95 band. Orange: C2 median and band. Grey shade: the labelled event. Sky-blue bar along the bottom: gate on or held.
